description:
We are two passionate girls from Kyzylorda, Kazakhstan, interested in space exploration, STEM, and innovation! 🚀

Our research on Aralkum dust as a potential Martian regolith analog won second place at a national-level science competition. We aim to combine science, technology, and creativity to develop impactful solutions for space exploration.

We're looking for enthusiastic teammates skilled in programming, data analysis, and UI/UX design who share our passion for space and innovation!
